summary: The frozen PR-179 result is not statistically closeout-ready. The implementation replaces the prospectively frozen centered_log_e_DMzp nuisance with centered log total sigma, so the response gates, cross-fit score, restricted-residual null, coefficient summaries, stability result, and terminal rank all correspond to a different estimand. The H-only terminal also bypasses the spec's explicit Q_RESPONSE_FAILURE_WITH_H_PASS route, and the directional-cubic q stress omits its frozen canonical-correlation check. Finite-rank arithmetic, fold construction, conditional null lineage, H coefficient mapping, and q coefficient withholding otherwise replay consistently from the supplied evidence.

findings.title: The fitted nuisance is log total sigma, not the frozen log reported e_DMzp
findings.statement: The spec freezes centered_log_e_DMzp as a nuisance. The implementation reads e_DMzp, folds it together with a velocity floor and a 0.05 mag systematic floor into sigma, discards the separate e_DMzp vector from PreparedDirectionalCatalogue, and then constructs the column named centered_log_e_DMzp from log(data.sigma). Since the added floors are positive and the velocity floor varies with Vcmb, log(sigma) is not the frozen log(e_DMzp) column. This changes the reduced and full designs used by response identifiability, all five cross-fit fits, OOF residuals, restricted-residual permutations, the observed/null scores, full-sample H coefficients, and deletion stability. The published rank 3/20000 and terminal therefore do not validate the frozen estimand.
evidence: docs/research_program/long_horizon_rescue/pr179_spec.yaml:232-249 freezes centered_log_e_DMzp in the nuisance set and defines the H-only score
htt/obsstat/directional_cosmography.py:224-244 reads e_dmzp but combines it with two floors into sigma
htt/obsstat/directional_cosmography.py:386-428 constructs the column named centered_log_e_DMzp from log(data.sigma)
htt/obsstat/directional_cosmography.py:442-474 and 764-885 propagate that design through cross-fit scoring and null calibration
assumptions: The frozen field name centered_log_e_DMzp denotes the reported table4 e_DMzp values, consistent with the source-column name and the separate variance_mag2 definition in the spec.
The velocity and systematic floors are weights/studentization terms and were not prospectively authorized as replacements for the reported-error nuisance.
findings.recommended_fix: Carry the raw positive e_DMzp vector in PreparedDirectionalCatalogue and construct the train-centered/scaled nuisance from log(e_DMzp); retain sigma only for WLS weighting and residual studentization. Then regenerate every PR-179 numerical artifact from scratch under the frozen hashes and re-run independent review. Do not reuse the current null stream as result evidence because its pseudo-outcomes and scores were built from the drifted reduced model.
findings.kill_switch: Until the corrected full 19,999-draw write/check replay and independent review pass, withhold the observed H amplitude, matched-null envelope, 3/20000 rank, stability PASS, and directional-residual terminal.

findings.title: The H-only result does not follow the frozen terminal-routing table
findings.statement: The authoritative routing order maps Q_RESPONSE_FAILURE_WITH_H_PASS to H_ONLY_SELECTION_SYSTEMATICS_CONDITIONAL. The observed response result is exactly H pass, q fail, H_ONLY, but _terminal has no H-only terminal branch and instead continues to the MC guard, emitting CATALOGUE_SELECTION_SYSTEMATICS_CONDITIONAL_DIRECTIONAL_RESIDUAL. H_ONLY_SELECTION_SYSTEMATICS_CONDITIONAL is unreachable in the implementation. Even if the intended scientific design was a nested H-only MC branch, that nesting is not what the frozen truth table states and may not be silently inferred after observing the result.
evidence: docs/research_program/long_horizon_rescue/pr179_spec.yaml:346-356 gives the ordered terminal mapping, including the H-only label
htt/obsstat/directional_cosmography.py:909-949 lacks a Q-fail/H-pass return and routes H_ONLY through the generic MC outcomes
assumptions: The spec and gate registry are authoritative for terminal pass/fail criteria.
An arrow in terminal_routing.order denotes the emitted terminal unless a nested subroute is explicitly declared.
findings.recommended_fix: Adjudicate the frozen wording before accepting any result. Under the literal frozen contract, emit H_ONLY_SELECTION_SYSTEMATICS_CONDITIONAL when H passes and q fails, while retaining the H-only finite-rank calculation only as explicitly scoped supporting evidence. If a nested H-only MC terminal was intended, register that as a post-result contract defect rather than silently treating it as prospectively frozen.
findings.kill_switch: Do not close PR-179 with the current directional-residual terminal until the spec-to-code routing discrepancy is resolved in a hash-bound adjudication.

findings.title: The directional-cubic q stress omits its frozen canonical-correlation gate
findings.statement: The spec freezes both a minimum retained-information threshold and a maximum canonical-correlation threshold for the z_squared_times_n stress. The implementation computes retained_information_q_directional_cubic but computes only H-versus-q canonical correlation and applies that single value to q_pass. It never computes or reports the canonical correlation associated with the q/cubic stress. q already fails the retained-information threshold in all five folds, so this omission does not promote q in the current artifact, but it leaves a frozen response obligation unimplemented and untestable.
evidence: htt/obsstat/directional_cosmography.py:533-560 constructs the cubic residual but applies only correlation=_canonical_correlation(h_res,q_res)
docs/generated/pr179_response_identifiability.json reports no directional-cubic canonical-correlation field and shows retained information 0.00834 to 0.00973, below 0.05 in every fold
assumptions: The stress-local max_canonical_correlation is distinct from max_H_q_canonical_correlation despite sharing the numerical threshold 0.95.
findings.recommended_fix: Define the stress correlation precisely, compute it from the frozen standardized weighted q and z_squared_times_n subspaces after the declared nuisance conditioning, include it in every fold receipt, and require it in q_pass. Add a mutation that changes only this correlation path.
findings.kill_switch: No future JOINT_H_Q promotion may rely on the current response gate.

checks_that_passed.result: The transformed response and H log-dipole map in the implementation agree algebraically with the frozen equations; the emitted H vector exactly equals -(ln(10)/5) times the three fitted H coefficients. The nuisance drift in F001 still invalidates the numerical values.

The supplied implementation learns nuisance centering/scaling, Nside4-by-depth counts, aliases, and reduced/full coefficients from each fold's training rows. Fold strata are preserved during permutation. No direct held-out-row coefficient or covariate leakage was found within the frozen cross-fit construction.

H passes rank/information/condition gates in all folds; q fails the directional-cubic retained-information gate in all folds. The numerical q coefficient vector, amplitude, axis, and null envelope are null, while only design-gate diagnostics remain.
